Proof in the paper.Ni/TiO2: The XRD patterns of Ni/TiO2 and Ni–Ir/TiO2 catalysts after reduction at 400°C are shown in Fig. 1. For the Ni/TiO2 catalyst (Fig. 1a), besides the diffraction of anatase TiO2, the metallic nickel was found at 2θ of 44.6° and 52.1°, indicating only the metallic nickel present on the surface of the reduced Ni/TiO2.
Proof in the paper.Ni–Ir/TiO2: In the case of Ni–Ir/TiO2 catalyst (Fig. 1b), the diffraction intensity of the anatase TiO2 decreases and the diffraction peak of nickel (2 0 0) at 2θ = 52.1° was rather weak and almost cannot be detected. The crystal size of Ni was about 9.1 nm from the Ni(1 1 1) at 2θ = 44.6°, which was smaller than that of the Ni/TiO2 catalyst.
